title: Electric Service Area Boundary
description:
This layer represents the geographic boundary of the electric utility service area managed by the City of Hagerstown's Light Department. The boundary identifies the general area where the City provides electric utility services and maintains responsibility for the associated electric distribution system.

The layer supports electric utility operations by providing a geographic reference for identifying service territory limits, coordinating infrastructure maintenance, evaluating service availability, planning system improvements, and supporting utility-related projects.

The electric service area may extend beyond the City of Hagerstown's municipal boundaries into surrounding areas of Washington County, Maryland, where electric service is provided by the City.

This dataset is maintained as part of the City of Hagerstown's enterprise GIS and is intended for use by authorized City personnel involved in electric utility operations, engineering, infrastructure management, service planning, and related municipal activities.

Data Accuracy and Limitations:

This boundary is intended for general reference, planning, and operational purposes. It should not be considered a legally authoritative determination of electric service territory or a guarantee of electric service availability at a specific property.

Actual electric service availability, service territory limits, and utility responsibilities should be verified with the City of Hagerstown Light Department.
